sanskrit: vihitāḥ pūrvaśaivānāṃ saṃmatāḥ śrutisaṃtateḥtānadya śrotukāmā'smi prasanno brūhyaśeṣataḥsadyomuktipradānadya madīyajñānasādhanānpunarbhavaprahāṇāya mumukṣustatsamācaretyoṣidvā parigṛhṇīyāt sadyomuktiṃ yadīcchatikāṅkṣeta muktiṃ yaḥ sadyaḥ sa etadvratamācaretsamyak parīkṣya vai śiṣyaṃ gṛhṇīyād deśikottamaḥanyathā guruśiṣyau tau patato narakāmbudhauityevaṃ nāmabhiḥ puṇyairnigamānteṣu gīyatedīkṣātrayeṇa saṃdahya liṅgatrayamupādiśetkuryād dīkṣāṃ mahāśaivīmavidyāpāśakṛntinīmdīyate kṣīyate yasmāt sā dīkṣeti nigadyatekriyātmikā parā kācidevameva tridhā bhavetśiṣyapāṇitale dattā yā dīkṣā sā kriyā bhavettatprakāraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasāmaṇḍapaṃ kārayet samyagvakṣye tallakṣaṇaṃ yathādīkṣārthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyutamcaturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ catustoraṇabhūṣitamaśvattha uttarasyāṃ ca plakṣaḥ paścimato bhavethastamātrasamutsedhāṃ darpaṇodarasannibhāmpūrvasmiṃścaturaśraṃ syādvahnau pippalapatravatvṛttaṃ syādvāraṇe bhāge vāyavye tu ṣaḍaśrakamsyādīśānendrayormadhye vṛttaṃ vā caturaśrakamcaturaśrārdhacandre ca vṛttaṃ padmaṃ ca vartulamīśānyāṃ caturaśraṃ vā vṛttaṃ vā'pi prakalpayet

sanskrit: maṇḍapaṃ racayitvaivaṃ dhvajādyaistaṃ vibhūṣayetrambhābhirdarbhamālābhirdarpaṇairdhūpavartibhiḥpañcavarṇayutaiścūrṇairathavā śubhravarṇakaiḥgururmāheśvaraiḥ sārdhaṃ prāpya maṇḍapamasya tuoṃ hāṁ vidyākalābhikhyadvārāya nama ityapipūrvādīni samabhyarcya tatastacchākhayornyasetvṛṣaṃ skandaṃ tathā devaṃ caṇḍaṃ dvau dvau caturṣvapighātratrayaṃ tathā kṛtvā vighnānutsārya yatnataḥantaḥ praviśya yāgopakaraṇānyavalokya casukhāsane tūpaviśet kuśādiparikalpitepātraṃ gṛhītvā prabrūyādevaṃ sadgurusannidhauiti vijñāpya tatpātraṃ saṃsthāpyāgre'bhivādayetparigṛhya gaṇānujñāmupaviśyāsane punaḥgaṇeśapūjanaṃ kuryāt svastipuṇyāhavācanamdehatrayagatānādimalatrayanivṛttayeṣaḍadhvaśuddhipūrveṇa śāmbhavena vratenaiti saṃkalpya dadyācca sapta dīkṣāḥ kriyāntarāḥsvāyattamiti saptaitāḥ kriyādīkṣāntarā matāḥityājñādīkṣayā'diśya tatastvevaṃ vaded guruḥprāṇānāyamya vidhivat pañcagavyāni sādhayetcaturṇāṃ caturācāryā madhyasya ca svayaṃ bhavetsadyojātaṃ ca pūrvasmin vāmadevaṃ tu dakṣiṇetattanmantraiḥ samāvāhya pūjayettadanantaramśivaliṅgaṃ samuddhṛtya pañcasūtropalakṣitamgharṣaṇādikriyājātajātadoṣopaśāntaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivaliṅgaṃ snāpayāmītyabhiṣiñcedanantaramabhiṣiñcediṣṭaliṅgaṃ pañcabrahmamanūttamaiḥnikṣipya gandhapuṣpādyairarcayed deśikottamaḥvāruṇe maṇḍale prasthamitapānīyapūritejalādhivāsanaṃ kuryādabliṅgairmanubhistataḥtatpātraṃ tu vinikṣipya maṇḍale vāyukoṇagetaduktamantraiḥ saṃsnāpya liṅgamudvartya vāsasānidhāya gandhapuṣpādyairarcayed deśikastataḥtadvidhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāsataḥtadardhaistaṇḍulaiścaiva tadardhaiśca tilaistathādarbhairācchādya talliṅgaṃ prākchiraskamadhomukhamliṅge nikṣipya tasyāṣṭadikṣukumbhān vinikṣipetvastrairācchādya kurvīta śivāgnimukhamapyathamaṇḍale pūrvadiksaṃsthe nikṣipya ca samarcayetdhānyādhivāsakalitamaṇḍalīkalaśodakaiḥadhvanyāsān ṣaḍapyatra liṅge saṃkalpyapūrvakamtatkañje tu padādhvānaṃ varṇādhvānaṃ ca madhyakemantrādhvānaṃ ca vinyasya gandhādyairabhipūjayetpañcākṣareṇa manunā satāreṇa tathā punaḥjayādibhiśca juhuyādagniṃ rakṣedanantaramkūrmāsanoparigate kuśādiparikalpiteviśodhya dehaṃ tadanu vidadhyād bhūtaśodhanampañcagavyena tasyātha kuryādantarviśodhanamanādibhavasaṃpannasarvadoṣopaśāntayepañcatattvaviśuddhyarthaṃ pañcabrahmamanūn japan
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viśvettāteti taddhaste badhnīyāt kaṅkaṇaṃ tataḥsvastikārohaṇābhikhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ dadyādyathāvidhipādādiṣu tu vinyasyecchiṣyasya niyatātmanaḥartharūpaṃ kalādhvānaṃ meḍhre nyasyedanantaramtattvādhvānaṃ tvartharūpaṃ hṛdi nyasyedatandritaḥartharūpaṃ ca bhuvanādhvānaṃ nyasyecchirasyapiṣaḍakṣarāṇi vinyasya ṣaḍvāraṃ deśikastataḥtataḥ śikhādisthāneṣu rudrākṣān dhārayet kramātśiṣyasya dakṣiṇe haste badhnīyād bandhamuktayepañcākṣareṇa juhuyāt satāreṇa ghṛtena vaisaṃhāramudrayā'ropya pidadhyānmaṇḍaladvayamanantaraṃ gururdadyād dīkṣāmāyatttasaṃjñitāmśānteśvarābhidhaṃ sarvamantranyāsopaśobhitamsaumyaitalliṅgamīkṣasvetīṣṭaliṅgaṃ pradarśayetcūrṇikāmaṅgaladhvānaiḥ paṭheyurmaṅgalāṣṭakamaṅgatraye'pi dṛḍhato liṅgavān bhava sarvadādhruvaṃ ta iti mantreṇa nikṣipenmaṅgalākṣatānniveśayan tasya dadyād dīkṣāṃ svāyattasaṃjñitāmvāmahastaṃ tu śiṣyasya mūlenaivābhimantrya catataḥ saptāpi dadyācca dīkṣāstāḥ samayādikāḥnirvāṇākhyā tṛtīyā syāt tattvasaṃjñā caturthikāsaptamī tattvabodhā syād vedhādīkṣāntarā imāḥkariṣya iti saṅkalpya tanmūrdhānaṃ samarcya cataṃ śiṣyaśirasi nyasya paṭhedekāgramānasaḥbho śiṣyeti ca sambodhya brūyādevaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ samayamādiśya niḥsaṃsārāṃ nibodhayetityādiśya ca dayācca dīkṣāṃ nirvāṇasaṃjñitāmiti nirvāṇamādiśya dadyāt tattvābhidhāyinīmupadiśyaivamatha ca dadyādadhyātmasaṃjñitāmādiśyaivaṃ tato dadyāt tattvasaṃśodhanātmikāmācāraliṅgamukhyebhyaḥ ṣaḍliṅgebhyaḥ samarpayetdadyāddīkṣāṃ vidhānajñaḥ kṛpāparavaśo guruḥbodhākhyayā dīkṣayaivaṃ śiṣyamādiśya deśikaḥsapta caikāgracittādyā dadyād dīkṣā anukramātpañcendriyārpaṇābhikhyā tṛtīyā parikīrtitāsaptamī tu samākhyātā sadyomuktisamāhvayāityekāgramatiṃ datvā dīkṣāṃ dadyād dṛḍhavratāmdṛḍhavratāmiti proktvā dadyāt pañcendriyārpaṇāmityādiśya tato dadyādahiṃsāsaṃjñitāṃ guruḥmā hiṃsīrityupādiśya liṅganiṣṭhāmupādiśetdīkṣāmupadiśed bhūyo liṅgarūpamanolayāmityādiśya punardadyāt sadyomuktisamāhvayāmprāṇeṣvantariti spaṣṭaṃ śivena vacaseti catrivāramupadiśyaivaṃ bhāvitāṃ manudīkṣayāliṅge niveśayet kṣipraṃ mūlamantramanusmaranyathā manastathā dṛṣṭiryathā dṛṣṭistathā sthalamdehaprāṇātmasuvyāptā saṃsthitā śāmbhavī kalātasyordhve tu śikhā sūkṣmā cidrūpā paramā kalāprāṇapratiṣṭhāmantraṃ ca mūlamantraṃ pathedapikiñca bhaktaikagātrastvaṃ bhavetyabhyarthayecca mām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śiṣyamādiśya dadyācca pādatīrthaprasādakaumāheśvarān guruṃ liṅgaṃ samyagarcaya nityaśaḥpravartasva mahābuddhe pañcācāreṣvapi kramātaṅgaliṅgapratiṣṭhākhyāṃ dīkṣāṃ śiṣyasya dhīmataḥnamo brahmaṇa ityetaṃ dhṛtimantraṃ samuccarangurvantevāsinorvāsa ācchādakamanūtsṛjetgobhūmyādyairmahādānairdeśikaṃ paritoṣayetnātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcidvidyate mokṣasādhanamcittaśuddhyā bhaved bhaktiranyadevasamāśrayādevāntaraprasādena mayi bhaktiḥ prajāyatelabhyate matprasādena kasyāpyantimajanmanaḥna taṃ māyā'nubadhnāti na sa bhūyo'bhijāyatetasya nirdagdhabandhasya punarbandhaḥ kathaṃ bhavetamṛtasyāsya nikaṭaṃ kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ prayāsyatibhāsvatastasya tu tamaḥ sakāśāṃ kathameṣyatividuṣo nityatṛptasya kathaṃ śoko bhaviṣyatisa evātrādhikārī syānnānyo mokṣāya kalpategopanīyaṃ prayatnena kimataḥ śrotumicchasimahāpāśupatavidhirnāma prathamaḥ paṭalaḥetadākarṇanādasmi kṛtakṛtyā maheśvaratadapākuru kāruṇyāt prāṇeśa śṛṇu madvacaḥvratenānuṣṭhitena syāt kiṃ phalaṃ brūhi tattvataḥjñānādeva tu kaivalyamiti satyaṃ vaco mamavratenānena na vinā jñānāyādhikṛto bhavetupadiṣṭamapi jñānaṃ maruvanna prarohati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na phalāya bhavatyeva yathā sasyamarakṣitambhaktisiktaṃ mama jñānaṃ mokṣāya bhavati dhruvammama jñānena na vinā matprasādo bhaviṣyatitasmādīyaṃ mahādīkṣā mokṣadā niścitā khalutasmādasaṃśayaṃ devi vrametad vimuktidamtasmāt siddhā hi dīkṣāyā jñānasādhanatā paramrāgadveṣānubaddhaśca tasya muktiḥ kathaṃ bhavettametaṃ saṃśayaṃ chindhi karuṇāvaruṇālayarahasyaṃ kathayāmyadya tvatsaṃśayanivārakamprāṇotkramaṇavelāyāṃ vārāṇasyāmiva dhruvamtena vai mucyate janturmatprasādānna saṃśayaḥnaro yathecchācāro'pi na bhīyānmṛtyubandhanātmajjñānavimukhasyāpi śāmbhavavratasevinaḥdīkṣitaḥ pātakī caita syād gacchedbhairavayātanāmmadanugrahapātraḥ syānnapunarjanmabhāgbhavetbhaktādinindakaścet syānnarakī kālamakṣayamnahyatra saṃśayaḥ kāryo maduktau girikanyaketvayi prasanne jagati durlabhaṃ kimu vidyateśrutau kimasti viśayaḥ sā bhavatsūktireva hisaṃvṛttā gatasaṃdehā vṛṣavāha kṣamasva māmparipṛcchasva kimapi vakṣyāmi girinandinidṛśyate jñānaniṣṭhā hi yaterevocitā bhavetjñānaniṣṭhā kathaṃ sadhyā brūhi me karuṇānidhebrahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho yatistu vāpumān nāryathavā klībaḥ sarve mokṣādhikāriṇaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: matprasādavihīnāya vratametanna rocatejñānaṃ ca na vinā'nena śāmbhavena vratena tudvijānāṃ vaidikaṃ proktamanyeṣāṃ tāntrikaṃ smṛtammadārādhanabuddhyā yatkarma tad jñānasādhanamkuṭumbake vinirdiṣṭaṃ paramaṃ mokṣasādhanamliṅganiṣṭhāgariṣṭhasya viduṣo gṛhamedhinaḥgṛhamedhīva samprāptuṃ kathaṃ pātrī bhavedyatiḥyatiḥ sannaviraktaścennarakī kālamakṣayammanniṣṭhāyuktacittaśced gṛhī mukto bhaved dhruvamko'pi vā bhavatālloke sa hi bandhādvimucyateito'pi paripṛcchasva kimanyacchrotumicchasipurastādvā parastādvā kartavyaṃ pāṇipīḍanātadhikārastu tadyogyavivāhāsaṃskṛtatvataḥgṛhyate śāmbhavī dīkṣā bhartṛśced guruḥ sa hipatyurgurorvā vacasi sthātavyamanayā punaḥtāsāmasyāṃ hi dīkṣāyāmadhikāraṃ kathaṃ bhavetjñāne labhetāvakāśaḥ patimatyāḥ kathaṃ prabhokathaṃ vā bhartṛśuśrūṣā kathaṃ putrādipālanamtāsāṃ kathaṃ nu yujyeta devatopāsanaṃ vadaanuṣṭheyaṃ parastādvai niyataṃ pāṇipīḍanātbharttaryaśakte grahaṇamanyato vā viśiṣyateabrāhmaṇasya patyurvā nopadeṣṭṭatvamiṣyategurudṛṣṭirvidheyo syādanyathā patato dhruvamtasmādanyagurutve'pi na bādhā yoṣito bhavettadanyena hi bhuktāyā eva syādanyaśeṣatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pitṛtā tasya gauṇī syānaiva mukhyā bhavedyataḥna tāvatā bhartṛbhāryāsambadho bādhyate dhruvamsiddhā vimokṣādhikṛtirna niroddhuṃ hi śakyatetataśca devatopāstiḥ śastā syādyoṣitāmapinārīnaratvādikamapyaihajanmikamīritamyadyaccharīmādhatte tena tena sa lipyatenirundhataḥ kathaṃ tanvyāḥ panthānaṃ mokṣagāminammadupāstiṃ vinā mūrkhastārayet sa kathaṃ satīmtasmādavaśyaṃ nārīṇāmanuṣṭheyaṃ vrataṃ bhavetna yogyā paricaryāyai dīkṣiṇīyā satī tataḥsa sa naivārhati kila pāko mahyaṃ niveditumabhiṣekakriyādīnāṃ mama nārhati tajjalamtasmādavaśyaṃ nārīṇāṃ dīkṣā deyā budhottamaiḥna duṣyate tato nārī bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇādiṣupālayantyapi putrādīn liṅganiṣṭhāṃ na vismarettato na gṛhakṛtyāni bādhante madupāsanāmpatyuḥ saṃsevanād bhartrā matsayujyaṃ gamiśyatiliṅgasparśanapūjādyāḥ karaṇīyāḥ kathaṃ prabhona mantrā vaidikā yogyā yoṣitāṃ tāntrikāḥ smṛtāḥprasavapramukhāpatsu pūjābhaṅgo na doṣadaḥvaidikī yadi pūjāyāṃ mantrāḥ syustāntrikāḥ kathamtamenaṃ saṃśayaṃ chindhi karuṇāvaruṇālayatāntrikyāmadhikāraḥ syādbhartuṃ strīṇāṃ svatantrataḥdīkṣābhedastu dampatyorna sāṅgatyanirodhaḥsarvamuktaṃ samāsena kimataḥ śrotumicchasi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāmbhavadīkṣāmāhātmyakathanaṃ nāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥśāmbhavavratināṃ nityamāhnikaṃ brūhi me'dhunānetrayoḥ sparśayanniṣṭaliṅgaṃ māmanusaṃsmaretdivyarūpamarūpaṃ vā cintayenmāmananyadhīḥbhuktiṃ ca kāminīsaktimadhītiṃ suptimeva caprāṇānāyamya ca japenmūlamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamprātaḥkāle tu yaḥ paśyet so'bhīṣṭaṃ samavāpnuyātprātaḥkāle tu yaḥ paśyet so'niṣṭaṃ samavāpnuyātśarakṣepamitāṃ tatra jalapātraṃ nidhāya vaiśiraḥ prāvṛtya nordhvaṃ ca nādhaścaiva vilokayantataśca visṛjenmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca samāhitaḥśaucaṃ tu yatnataḥ kuryādanyathā niṣphalāḥ kriyāḥyaḥ smaredvai virūpākṣaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraḥ śuciḥjalaṃ mahyaṃ samarpyaiva gaṇḍūṣān visṛjettadākṛtvopavītaṃ savyāṃse tata ācamanaṃ caretudaṅmukhastu tīrthena brāhmeṇopaspṛśejjalamkṛtvā mūtrapurīṣe ca śaucārthī samupaspṛśetkuśagrahaḥ praśastaḥ syānna śastaḥ paitṛke bhavetmadhurityādimantreṇa śākhāṃ samabhimantrya caiti samprārthya mantreṇa dhāvayecchākhayā tathāna vilvaśākhayā kuryād dantaśuddhiṃ kadācanagartapraśravaṇadīni śastāni snānakarmaṇimedhāduḥsvapnanāśaśca guṇāḥ snānasya kīrtitāḥśivagaṅgeti vijñeyā tatra snātvā labhet māmmalasnānamidaṃ proktaṃ mantrasnāmatha śṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devatātarpaṇaṃ caiva snānaṃ pañcāṅgamucyatesevitaṃ tu jalaṃ nityaṃ tasmād duṣṭaṃ bhavedataḥhuṃphaḍantena cāstreṇa mṛdaṃ gṛhṇīta sādhakaḥpūrvasmin dakṣiṇe caiva tathā caivottare kṣipetastraṃ brahmaśivaṃ japtvā pūrvādi kramaśo nyasetśivajaptaṃ tu yadbhāgaṃ tīrthamadhye vinikṣipetjale sūkṣmāśca ye doṣāsteṣāmuccāṭanaṃ bhavetśiro vaktraṃ ca hṛdayaṃ pādau guhyaṃ ca bhāgaśaḥupaspṛśya tathā snāyācchivatīrthasya madhyataḥpañcabrahmaśivāṅgaiśca triḥ paṭhedaghamarṣaṇammārjanaṃ saṃhitāmantraistattoyena samācaretiḍayāntargataṃ tena dagdhameno vicintayetdhṛtvā jalaṃ tatra pāpapūruṣaṃ bhāvayettataḥcūrṇitaṃ bhāvayet pāpanaramityaghamarṣaṇamdevaṃ māṃ madgaṇāṃścaiva tarpayecchuddhamānasaḥtatastu dhautavasane dhṛtvā tvaktvā''rdravāsasībhasmasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryācchuddhāntaḥkaraṇaḥ śuciḥśira īśānamantreṇa puruṣeṇa mukhaṃ tathāpādau sadyena sarvāṅgaṃ praṇavenaiva secayetuddhūlanamidaṃ paścād sajalenaiva kuṇṭhayetpraṇavaṃ tanmukhe caiva vāyakārau bhujadvayevilikhya mūlamantreṇa ṣaḍvāramabhimantrayetnāsāvaktragaleṣvevamaṃsadvitayake tathānābhau guhyadvaye caiva ūrvoḥ sphgbimbajānuṣubhasma tripuṇḍraṃ saṃdhārya rudrākṣān bibhṛyāttataḥ

sanskrit: ṣaṭtriṃśattu gale dadyād bāhvoḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśaaṣṭottaraśatairmālāṃ japayajñe prakalpayetsaptakaṃ daśakaṃ vā'pi bibhṛyāt kaṇṭhadeśataḥkeyūrakaṭake caiva kakṣabandhe viśeṣataḥsahasramuttamaṃ proktamevaṃ bhedena dhārayetsaviturmaṇḍalasvāmī sāvitrīdevatā'smyahamcatvāri tasya naśyanti hyāhuḥ prajñā yaśo balambhargamukhyābhidhānaśca prāṇadhīcodakaḥ sadāuttamairarcanīyo'haṃ ṣaṭkālaṃ bhaktiśālibhiḥaruṇasyodaye kuryāt pūjāṃ tātkālikīṃ tataḥupatiṣṭhecca saviturantaraṃ māmananyadhīḥjapet ṣaḍakṣarīṃ sāṅgāṃ śrīrudrādīn viśeṣataḥjapayajñaṃ samāpyaivaṃ gurvādīnabhivādayetdvitīyabhāge tvabhyasyed vedān divyāgamānapitadā samācared bhaktyā pūjāṃ saṅgavakālikīmpuṣpāṇi vilvapatrāṇi guggulvādīni cāharettathā caturthabhāge tu snānārthaṃ mṛdamāharettataḥ pañca mahāyajñāḥ kartavyā gṛhiṇā mudābrahmaṇaśca vinirdiṣṭāḥ pañcayajñā nagātmajedadātyapaḥ pitṛbhyo'yaṃ pitṛyajña itīritaḥyat svādhyāyamadhīyīta brahmayajña itīryatepunastanna vidheyaṃ syāt svapitṝṇāṃ tu tarpaṇemahatī vā yathāśakti śraddhābhaktiyutātmanāsamprāpto yastu pūjānte sa evāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥannapānādibhiścaiva tadabhīṣṭapradānataḥ

sanskrit: sukhamāshāya maccittastadannaṃ pariṇāmayanāsāyamatha kurvīta yatnaṃ poṣyārthasiddhayekṛtvā sāyantanīṃ pūjāṃ vaiśvadevaṃ samācaretsāyamāyāntamatithiṃ pūjayedatibhaktitaḥsāyaṃ hi vimukhe tasmiṃstadaṣṭaguṇitaṃ bhavetprasādamupabhujyātha matstotrāṇi paṭhedapismaran samādhimāsthāya śayītā'rvākchirāḥ sukhamdvijānāṃ mama bhaktānāṃ matpadaprāptisādhanamāhnikavidhirnāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥaśrauṣamāhnikaṃ deva bhaktānāmiṣṭadāyakamraṅgavallīvidhānaṃ ca vartikāsādhanaṃ tathāśrotumicchāmi bhagavan vada me karuṇānidhematpūjā trividhā laghvī gurvī ca mahatī tathālaghvīmaśaktaḥ kuryācca sāyaṃ mādhyāhnike tathātrikālamarcanāṃ kuryācchaktaḥ ṣaṭkālameva vāmadarcanāṃ vidhāyaiva sāvitrīṃ prajapennaraḥjapayajñaṃ vidhāyaivaṃ pūjāmudayakālikīmsāyaṃ sandhyāmupāsyārcyāṃ kuryāt sāyantanīṃ tathāgṛhī niśyardharātrārcāṃ śraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥgṛhiṇaśca yaterdharātrapūjāvasānagaudvitīyayāme kartavyā mama pūjārdharātrikīnaktavratī yadi punarviśeṣastvadhunocyateyāmāt purastāt kartavyā mama pūjā na bhojanātatpūrvaḥ śasyate kālo nityanaktopajīvināmyataḥ prasādaḥ saṃsevyo niyataṃ naktabhojinām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sitataṇḍulacūrṇena padmaṣṭadalaṃ bhavetekonapañcāśatkoṣṭhacakramevaṃ bhavet tataḥdaśāyudhāni vinyasyet parito maṇḍalaṃ punaḥdakṣiṇe cāmaraṃ chatraṃ nairṛtyāṃ pañcakoṇakamuttare ḍamaruṃ śūlamaiśāne tvaṣṭakoṇakambhadramaṇḍalamākhyātaṃ bhadradaṃ muktidaṃ paramṣaṇṇavatyuttaradvādaśaśatātmakakoṣṭhakamdaśāyudhāni vinyasyet parito maṇḍalaṃ budhaḥtattvamaṇḍalamākhyātaṃ tattvānubhavasādhanambhadramaṇḍalamukhyāni gurvyādiṣu ca vinyasetgurvyāṃ mahatyāmapi ca dvau vā'tha caturo'pi vātṛtīyamavasarākhyamevaṃ saṃpūjayet priyeprathamaṃ darśanākhyaṃ syādavasarākhyaṃ dvitīyakamkarpūrākhyaṃ pañcamaṃ syāt ṣaṣṭhaṃ śṛṅgārasaṃjñakamasaṃkhyātābhidhaṃ caitannavamaṃ parikīrtitamgurvarcane'pi hi bhavantyekādaśa priyavratenava dvādaśa vā proktā vartikā laghupūjaneānavakramasaṃkhyā vā tathā ṣaṇṇavatistu vāmahatyāṃ mama pūjāyāṃ vartikā jvālayedapiphalaṃ tisṛbhireva syādaṣṭottaraśatoditamnandyāvartaśriyāvartakaravīrabakāni calodhradhuttūranirguṇḍīvilvāśokamunīnyapietāni sāttvikāni syurmuktidāni bhavanti himiśrāṇi pītavarṇāni bhogamokṣapradāni hipūjāyāmupayujyeranna kadāpi nitambini
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: a'svamedhaphalaṃ dadyurvasante mahyamarpaṇātagniṣṭomaphalaṃ dadyurgrīṣmatau varavarṇinisatrayāgaphalaṃ dadyuḥ śaradyarpaṇato mamaśatakratuphalaṃ dadyācchiśire karṇikārakampraśastatamamākhyātaṃ matpūjāyāṃ varānanetadanantaphalaṃ vidyāt pūjanaṃ mama pārvatinahi nirmālyatādoṣastasmāt tairnityamarcayetapavitrajanānītaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ tyajetavṛntaṃ savraṇaṃ puṣpaṃ pūjāyāṃ nopayujyatepatrāṇyapi tathā nyasyed vilvapatramadhomukhamsarvopari nyasedbhasma bhasmopari na kiñcanasarvamuktaṃ samāsena kimataḥ śrotumicchasiraṅgavalyādikathanaṃ nāma caturthaḥ paṭalaḥjagadīśvara sarvātman bhūyo bhūyo namo'stu tepūjākāle sādhakena vartitavyaṃ yathā punaḥbrūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa prāṇinirvāṇakāraṇamnirmalenaiva manasā pūjakaḥ phalabhāg bhavetpuṣkale pūjane bhaktaḥ puṣkalāṃ śriyamaśnutesamāsīnaḥ saniyamaḥ pūjayenmāmananyadhīḥpunaryatena mūḍhātmā na pūjāphalabhāg bhavetmadhye madhye samāhūya cañcalo na phalī bhavetpūjakaḥ krodhasaṃkruddhaḥ sannidhiṃ nābhigacchativarjayeviṣayāsaktiṃ punaḥ kuryānmadarpitamsannidhāyātha yatnena manasaivārpayenmayitatkāryaṃ manasi smṛtvā na pūjāphalamaśnute
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tvarayenmama pūjāyāṃ naiti māṃ tasya pūjanamnivedite'pi cāhūtastadājñāṃ paripālayetabhedabhāvanāṃ jñātvā tadājñāṃ paripālayetnekṣeta pūjāvelāyāṃ naraṃ devi bahiṣkṛtamkuryāt sarvaprayatnena tadaśaktau tu kārayetśivadroheṇa niryāti kālabhairavayātanāmmodate tasya nāvṛttistena sarvaṃ vaśīkṛtamphalaṃ tathā tathā teṣāṃ dātā'haṃ hi sadāśivaḥsaṃpādya pūjayelliṅgaṃ yathāvibhavavistaramrājataṃ vā daridraścet tāmrapātraṃ hi kalpayetsauvarṇapātrapūjā'pi na tasyāḥ sadṛśī bhavettatpātrasadṛśaṃ loke nāsti nāsti mahītalenīlotpalaṃ ca puṣpeṣu pūjārthamuttamottamamśuddhabhāvaḥ samabhyarcya yathoktaphalabhāg bhavetśūdrānītaiḥ krayakrītaiḥ karma kurvan patatyadhaḥtilākṣatairarcayenmāṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasāsāmānyārghyābhidhaṃ caiva pādārghyācamanāni caśivakumbhasamākhyaṃ ca pātrāṇyekādaśa priyegandhāderapi dhūpasya dīpānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥtālvṛntaṃ ca saṃpādya yajenmāṃ liṅgarūpiṇampātraṃ daśapalaiḥ kuryāt sāmānyārghyasamākhyakamādhārābhikhyapātrāṇi sārdhadvipalamānataḥsthūlodaraṃ tathā kuryānmukhagrīvāvibhūṣitamtyāgajñānānandakāni vartulānītarāṇi cadīpapātrāṇi kuryācca ḍamarvākāravanti ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chatraṃ saṃpādayed dhīmān muktājālavibhūṣitamatha yajñīyavṛkṣeṇa mṛdā pātraṃ tu kārayetvijane svagṛhe vā'pi yajedekāgramānasaḥdroṇapuṣpasahasrairvā puṣpairvāthārkasaṃbhavaiḥśatamaṣṭottaraṃ vā'pi cāṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyayālaukikānyakathālāpaṃ varjayenmama pūjakaḥanyapūjārhapuṣpāṇi na ca mahyaṃ samarpayetyācanālabdhapuṣpāṇyapraśastāni madarcanedhūpadīpau samarpyātha na vilambennivedanepañcadravyāṇi kalaśe cūrṇayitvā vinikṣipetcandraṃ ca kusumaṃ caiva pādyapātre vinikṣipetcandanaṃ bhasma kusumamarghyapātre vinikṣipetbhasmacandanapuṣpāṇi pātreṣvanyeṣu nikṣipetānandapātre śītaṃ ca jalamāpūrayet tathāekānte mīlitākṣeṇa dhyānaṃ kāryaṃ vipaścitāmanodārḍhyena sampannaḥ pūjayenmāṃ dṛḍhavrataḥnamaskārapriyo bhānurmama stotrapriyā gaṇāḥstotramātreṇa saṃtuṣṭastvahamiṣṭaphalapradaḥdhyānānuguṇamevānyanmukhyaṃ dhyānaṃ prakīrtitamgandhadravyeṇa miśrau ca kṛtvā māmabhipūjayetlavaṅgatvagjāṭāmāṃsyau takkolaṃ kuṣṭhameva cadevadāruṃ gugguluṃ ca kauṅkumaṃ puṣpameva casarvadravyāṇi nikṣipya pūjayelliṅgarūpiṇamelośīrairdaridraścenna kevalajalairyajettathā tathā phalaṃ proktaṃ bhaktānāṃ kilbiṣaṃ nahi

sanskrit: sapuṣpamarpayed bhaktaḥ svasya vijñānasiddhayeviśeṣāt somavāre ca dīpāvalisamarpaṇātnā punarjāyate bhakto mama sāyujyamāpnuyāttasmādajñānanāśāya dīpārcanamathācaretsahasraṃ vā prakurvīta namaskārapriyo'smyahamatha bhakto namaskāraṃ kaṇṭhordhvaṃ tu vibhāvayetprārthayenmāṃ maheśāni yathākāmamatandritaḥcinmudrayā ca puṣpāṇi pātrāṇi ca samarpayettālavṛntena cāpyevaṃ darpaṇaṃ darśayedapigītāni śrāvayedeva vādyaṃ nṛtyaṃ samarpayetgomayenopaliptaṃ ca raṅgavalyādyalaṅkṛtamsugandhadravyacūrṇaiśca dhūpayed devatāgṛhamvinyased vigrahānāśu teṣu māmakakiṅkarānbhasmatripuṇḍrarudrākṣabhāsvaddehān kapardinaḥteṣu teṣu ca nīḍeṣu dīpamālāṃ ca kalpayetbhasmatripuṇḍrarudrākṣamāikāsamalaṅkṛtaḥsakalīkṛtadehaśca kṛtapāriṣadastutiḥbhasmaśayyāñcitaṃ tatra karapīṭhaṃ vidhāya caṛgyajuḥsāmavedaiśca tathā'tharvaṇamantrataḥśāstrāṇāṃ paṭhanenāpi gadyapadyastutivrajaiḥvādyaiśca vividhairgītairnṛtyairmāṃ paritoṣayetjāghaṇṭāśaṅkhanādaiśca kolāhalaravairapinimajjanniva saṃtuṣṭo niḥsaṃjñaḥ iva tatparaḥtaṃ dṛṣṭvā modate yastu tamādapyadhiko bhavetsa yāti mama sāyujyaṃ jñānināmapi durlabham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pātrādisādanaṃ devi kimataḥ śrotumicchasipūjāpātrādilakṣaṇakathanaṃ nāma pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥavasarādipūjānāṃ kalpaṃ brūhi viśeṣataḥmaṇḍalaṃ parikalpyādau dīpaṃ prajvālayet tataḥmannāmabhiḥ samācamya prāṇānāyamya śaktitaḥaṣṭottaraśatānyūnāṃ japenmama ṣaḍakṣarīmnīrājanaṃ darśanākhyamasau ya iti darśayetetāvānasya mahimetyāmanan pādyamarpayetnamaḥ somāya cetyevam snānaṃ ca parikalpayetṛtaṃ satyamiti prāśya vastraṃ yastantviti bruvangandheti gandhamādadyādākāśāditi cākṣatānvilvaṃ triyambakamiti yacca vyometi dhūpakamdadyādavasaraṃ naivedyamācārādiliṅgakaiḥaṇoraṇīyāniti ca liṅgaṃ svāṅge niveśayetsnātaḥ śuciryatamānāḥ kṛtabhasmāvaguṇṭhanaḥācamya dīpaṃ prajvālya saṃprārthya ca gaṇānmamasaṃbhavadbhiriha dravyairiṣṭaliṅgasya pūjanamṣaḍakṣarajapaṃ kuryādaṣṭottaraśataṃ budhaḥnīrājanaṃ darśanākhyamasau ya iti darśayetetāvanasya mahimetyāmanan pādyamarpayetyo vai rudraḥ sa bhagavānāpa ityabhiṣicya caṛtaṃ satyamiti praśya puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ samarpya caphalādyavasaraṃ dadyād bhasma liṅgopari kṣipetnīrājanaṃ majjanākhyaṃ darśayed girinandinanihaṃsaḥ śuciṣadityarghyaṃ sāvitryā''camanīyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kadrudrāyeti saṃmantrya prāśnīta ṛtamityapiyo vai rudraḥ sa bhagavān yaścāgniriti dhūpanamvastraṃ samarpayed devi yastantviti manuṃ paṭhannamo harikeśāyeti yajñasūtraṃ samarpayetākāśāditi mantreṇa dadyāt kevalamakṣatāntadevartaṃ bhuvantaya iti mālyāni cārpyaetiti nīrājanaṃ dadyācchṛṅgārākhyaṃ maheśvaripuṣpāṇi tryambakamiti vilvapatrāṇi cārpayetnamo vātyāya cetyevaṃ cāmaraṃ parikalpayetsa yaścāyaṃ puruṣa ityarpayed darpaṇaṃ tathāadhyavocadadhityevaṃ śaṅkhaṃ samyaṅ ninādayetnamo rudrāyātatāyina iti nāṭyaṃ ca darśayetyo rudro'gnāviti paṭhan namaskāraṃ samarpayetajāta ityevamiti paṭhan yāñcāṃ vibhāvayetna tatra sūryo bhātīti mahānīrājanaṃ diśetcaturvidhaṃ ca naivedyamarpayet sādhakastataḥmūlamantreṇa cāpyevaṃ mantrapuṣpaṃ samarpayetānandābhikhyakaṃ nīrājanamapyarpayet tataḥpuṣpāñjaliṃ ca vikirannātmānamapi cārpayetaṇoraṇīyāniti ca kuryāt svāṅge niveśanammatsāyujyaprado hyeṣa yathoktamanutiṣṭhatāmpūjāvidhikathanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥtvatpūjākarṇanādasmi kṛtārthā jagadīśvaratadvidhānaṃ ca sambodhya kṛpayā'nugṛhāṇa māmsnātaḥ śuciryatamanā dhṛtadhautāmbaradvayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtasandhyādikaḥ sampāditapuṣpādisādhanaḥcatuṣṭayaṃ dīpikānāṃ prajvālya dvayameva vādeśakālau susaṃkīrtya ceṣṭaliṅgasya prītayebhasmacandanapuṣpāṇi tatra nikṣipya nirmalammantraiḥ sammantrya saṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryādvakṣyamāṇakaiḥdhenvākhyayā'mṛtīkṛtya padmaliṅge pradarśayettaduttareṇa vinyasyet pādyapātre yathākramambhasmacandanapuṣpāṇi nikṣipet sādhakottamaḥtaduttarepyarghyapātre kuśādīn vikṣipet tathāṣaḍaṅgairjalamāpūrya sadyādyairabhimantrayetuṣṇaṃ vai jalamāpūrya prāsādenābhimantrayetcandanodakamāpūrya cāghoreṇābhimantrayetśītalodakamāpūrya vāmadevena mantrayetvinyasettatra cādhārapātrāṇi trīṇi paṅtiśaḥtatra bhasmādi nikṣipya tadā pānīyakaṃ jalamāpo vā idaṃ sarvamityanenābhimantrya casāmānyārghyagataṃ toyaṃ pādyāditriṣu nikṣipettīrthaprasādau gṛhṇīyānmatpūjāyogyatāptayeayaṃ me hasta iti tu hastaśuddhiṃ vidhāya vaisarvaliṅgaṃ sthāpayatīti liṅgaṃ nikṣipet karesahasraṃ ṣaṭchataṃ vā'pi japedeva ṣaḍakṣarīmabhyukṣya nānudhyāyecca tamevaikamiti smarannīrājanaṃ sānurāgaṃ yā te rudreti nirdiśetmūlenaiva hi liṅgāgre puṣpaṃ nikṣipya mantritamtyāgapātrasthitenaiva liṅgaṃ saṃsnāpya vāriṇā

sanskrit: āvahantīti mantreṇa vastreṇodvartya sādarampraṇamyābhyarcya pādyaṃ ca jñānapātrajalena vaikadrudrāyeti saṃmantrya pibedṛtamitīrayannīrājanaṃ tvavasarābhikhyaṃ dattvā phalādikamsamarpya prāśya tatpātraṃ nikṣipedapyadhomukhamdattvā tatsavituriti tyāgapātrasthavāriṇānamaḥ śambhava ityātmamūrdhani prokṣayet tathābhasmāsane nidhāyāsya gṛhṇīyāt pādatīrthakamyovai rudraḥ sa bhagavān yaścāgniriti mantrataḥdaśāṅgamahitaṃ mahyaṃ dhūpaṃ dadyānmanoharamagnirityādibhirmantrairlimped bhasma sahodakamgandhadvārāmiti paṭhan dadyād gandhaṃ sahākṣatamākāśāditi vai dadyādakṣatāropaṇaṃ budhaḥnīrājanaṃ darśayecca karpūrākhyaṃ maheśvarinamo hiraṇyabāhave makuṭādi vibhūṣayetiti nīrājanaṃ dadyācchṛṅgārākhyaṃ maheśvarimūlenāpi ca puṣpāṇi patrāṇi ca samarpayetnama īdhriyāya ceti śvetacchatraṃ samarpayetcandramā manasa iti tālavṛntena vījayetyo vedādāviti paṭhan ghaṇṭānādaṃ samarpayetśivena vacasā tveti gītamāśrāvayet tathāpradakṣiṇāni prayato mama liṅgasya sarvataḥnamo vṛddhāya ca paṭhan stotraṃ kuryādananyadhīḥnantatra sūryo bhātīti mahānīrājanaṃ tathājyotiṣmatīmiti paṭhan jyotīṃṣi jvālayedapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jyotīṃṣi tāni kathyante mama prītikarāṇyapivedāntavijñāna iti pūjāpuṣpādikaṃ tyajetsthitaṃ cediṣṭaliṅgāgre nipated bhojyavastuṣutadalpaśeṣaṃ visṛjenna liṅgaṃ śūnyamastakamvikīrya sajalaṃ bhasma savyāhṛtikayā tathāṣaḍliṅgārpaṇasadbhāve viśeṣo'sthi śṛṇu priyegandhaprasādaṃ sadbhaktyā cittahastena cārpayetbuddhihastena tu ruciṃ niṣṭhābhaktyā samarpayetbhaktyā'vadhānayā rūpamahaṅkāreṇa cārpayetbhaktyā'nubhavayā manohastena sparśamarpayetānandabhaktyā sujñānahastenaiva samarpayetsadbhāvābhikhyahastena bhaktyā samarasākhyayāevamarpaṇasadbhāvaṃ sarvadaiva samabhyasetsamarpaṇe samarcāṅge ruciṃ bhāvena nānyathāaikyasthale tu mūlena liṅge puṣpaṃ nidhāya cayato vāco nivartante iti mantraṃ japan punaḥārabhyeti ca tāmbūlanīrājanamathārpayetmantrayan pu'pajātaṃ vai mantrapuṣpaṃ samarpayetasaṃkhyātābhikhyanīrājanamapyarpayet tataḥaṇoraṇīyāniti tu peṭikāyāṃ suvinyasetdeveśi gurupūjāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ kathyate śṛṇuna vidyante'tra pātrāṇi pātradvitayameva caśiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ samaṃ proktaṃ kimataḥ śrotumicchasiśivapūjāvidhānaṃ nāma saptamaḥ paṭalaḥvidhānamidamutkṛṣṭaṃ vedamantrasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: strīmukhyāḥ kena vidhinā kṛtārthāḥ syurnibodha meanuṣṭhitena yena syuḥ sarve sarvārthabhājanāḥtatra pañcākṣarastatra śiva ityakṣaradvayammadīyamūlamantreṇa pūjanaṃ sarvato varameṣu bhātyupacārārthaḥ spaṣṭaḥ sarvo'pi bhāminiteṣu teṣūpacāreṣu vedamantrā niyojitāḥteṣveva paṭhyamāneṣu cittaṃ kṛtye'nurajyatetanmantrāstāntrikā devi pūjāyāmuttamottamāḥvaidikānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca suvrateīśāna iti mantreṇa śivakumbhaṃ prapūjayetaghoro dakṣiṇe caiva sadyojātastu paścimeadhobhāge parā śaktirviśvodbhāsanakāriṇīmadhyasthaṃ jalamutkṛṣṭaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamamiti mantraiśca gandhādyaiḥ śivakumbhaṃ prapūjayetiti mantreṇeṣṭaliṅgaṃ vinyaset karapaṅkajeāvāhitaḥ suprasannaḥ sānnidhyaṃ kuru sarvadādaśāvadhānavidhinā ciraṃ liṅgaṃ samīkṣya canīrājanaṃ gṛhāṇeśa sānurāgaṃ sadāśivatataśca mūlamantreṇa bhasma puṣpaṃ nidhāya caiti darśananīrājanaṃ datvā pādyamarpayetiti pādyaṃ samarpyaiva hastayorarghyamarpayetiti cārghyaṃ samarpyāthācamanīyaṃ mukhe'rpayetdattvā''camanamityevaṃ snāpayediṣṭaliṅgakamśuddhodakasnānamidaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvarapādodakaṃ gṛhītvā ca namaskuryādanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti prāśya tato liṅgaṃ gandhādyairabhipūjayetnīrājanaṃ gṛhāṇeśāvasarākhyaṃ sadāśivadattvā majjananīrājanaṃ paścādabhidarśayetnīrājanaṃ gṛhāṇeśa majjanākhyaṃ suśobhanampūrvamantraiḥ pradāyātha snānaṃ ca parikalpayetpañcāmṛtasnānamidaṃ gṛhyatāṃ bhaktavatsalaśuddhodakasnānamidaṃ gṛhāṇa jagadīśvarapādatīrthaṃ gṛhītvā'tha namaskṛtyā'dareṇa tupāpapraśamanārthāya pādatīrthāya te namaḥityagninā vidhūmena tāpanaṃ saṃvidhāya casaṃvījya dhūpamityevaṃ punardhūpaṃ prasārayetiti māṅgalyanīrājanaṃ dattvā vastramarpayetvastrayugamaṃ samarpyaivaṃ bhūtiṃ saṃdhārayet tataḥiti saṃdhārya sajalaṃ bhasma gomayasaṃbhavamiti mantreṇopavītaṃ datvā gandhaṃ samarpayetiti gandhaṃ sākṣataṃ ca dattvā tena vilepayetiti śubhrākṣatān dattvā karpūraṃ dīpayet tataḥiti karpūranīrājanaṃ dattvā mālyamarpayetiti mālyaṃ pradāyāthābharaṇāni samarpayetbhuṣaṇairityaṅkṛtya nānāratnasamujjvalaiḥnīrājanaṃ gṛhāṇeśa śṛṅgārākhyaṃ sadāśivaaṣṭābhirnāmabhiścaivamaṣṭottaraśatena vāpu'pairevaṃ susaṃpūjya vilvapatrāṇi cārpayetiti vilvadalaṃ datvā bhasma sarvopari kṣipetchatramevaṃ samarpyātha cāmaradvayamarpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cāmarābhyāṃ vījayitvā tālavṛntena vījayettālavṛntena saṃvījya darpaṇaṃ ca pradarśayetdarpaṇaṃ darśayitvaivaṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ samarpayetghaṇṭhānādaṃ samarpyaivaṃ śaṅkhamāpūrayet tataḥśaṅkhaṃ ninādyaivamato gītamāśrāvayedapigītamāśrāvya ca tato vādyaṃ saṃśrāvayet tadāiti vādyaṃ ninādyātha nṛttaṃ samyak pradarśayetnṛttaṃ viracayāmyadya mahānaṭa vilokayamuṣṭyaivāṅguṣṭhayutayā pradakṣiṇamathārpayetpradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā namaskuryādanekaśaḥnamāṃsi tu samarpyaivaṃ stutiṃ kuryādanantaramstutiṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kuryād dhūpasaṃvījanaṃ budhaḥdhūpasaṃvījanaṃ śambho gṛhyatāṃ bhaktavatsalamahānīrājanamapi prajvālya ca samarpayetiṣṭaliṅgasvarūpāyābhīṣṭadāyāstu maṅgalamprāṇagranthisvarūpāya prāṇaliṅgāya maṅgalammahānīrājanaṃ dattvā yāñcāṃ kuryādanantaramyāce'haṃ yāce'haṃ punarapi tāmeva satatamiti vijñāpanāṃ kṛtvā nivedyaṃ prokṣayet tataḥtadvareṇyaṃ śaraṇyaṃ samupāsmahepariṣecanakaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍliṅgārpaṇamācaretiti nīrājanaṃ datvā tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayetiti dattvā ca tāmbūlaṃ nīrājanamathārpayetiti nīrājanaṃ datvā mantrapuṣpamathārpayetiti puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā'saṃkhyaṃ nīrājanaṃ diśet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīrājanamasaṃkhyātaṃ dattvā vastreṇa veṣṭayetiti vastreṇa saṃveṣṭya peṭikāyāṃ suvinyasetpeṭikāyāmiti nyasyedevamuktaṃ mahārcanamsuvāsinīnāṃ mukhyo'yaṃ laghrārādhanāvidhiḥsarvamuktaṃ samāsena kimataḥ śrotumicchasitāntrikapūjāvidhikathanaṃ nāma aṣṭamaḥ paṭalaḥarcāvidhānaśravaṇāt kṛtārthā'smi bhavanmukhātbrūhi tānakhilānīśa pāhi māṃ karuṇākaramatpūjātatpareṇāśu matprasādābhikāṅkṣiṇāsaṃkhyā niyamato nityaṃ grahaṇīyā na cānyathānopayojyaṃ hi kṛtyeṣu madarpaṇamukhādiṣuna kupyeccintayedanyān nānyaiḥ saṃllāpamācaretmannāma vāci ca tathā na kadāpi viyojayetna me'samarpya seveta prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairapisamarpitaṃ ca liṅgāya na cānyasmai samarpayetna bhojyamasamarpyeti gaditaṃ bhavataiva tuenaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chindhi karuṇāvaruṇālayanivedane viśeṣo'sti vakṣyāmyavahitā bhavatīrthasya cārpaṇaṃ proktamanujñārūpameva hilabhyante hyaniśaṃ bhogāsteṣu teṣvapi madvratīnivedanaṃ prakurvīta grāmyadharmādike tathāstrīṇāmanudinaṃ bhagnaṃ tādṛśaṃ hi samarpaṇamathavā'pyarcanaṃ kṛtvā kathaṃ kuryānnivedanambhuñjītānyatarat tatra sā kiṃ brūhyathavobhayamubhayaṃ caiva bhuñjīta bhaktiyuktā mayi priye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: matprasādaparityāgī matprasādaṃ sa nārhatidārebhyaścaiva śiṣyebhyaḥ kathaṃ deyaṃ prasādakamgaṇḍūṣakaraśddhyādi kathaṃ samupapadyatāmprasādasya pavitratvānmukhaśuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhavetsamarpitena yadi tat kathaṃ samupapadyateetatsarvaṃ samāvedya bhaktānīkaṃ samuddharapradānenārpitatyāgadoṣo naivāsti bhāminiyathā'vidhikṛtatyāgo na doṣo guṇa eva hitāstāḥ kriyā hi kartavyāḥ kurvannevaṃ na duṣyatitatrāvaśakṛtatyāgo na doṣo vidhimūlakaḥlālāsambandharāhityāttatra śuddhirna hīṣyatemannāmacintanodyukto nānyadevādikaṃ smarettvadekaniṣṭhāparamaiḥ kartavyāstāḥ kathaṃ prabhotanmantryādeśca kaiṅkaryaṃ bhṛtyasya nahi duṣyatinityanaimittike cānyadevasevā na duṣyatina prayacchedabhaktebhyo vijātīyebhya eva caadhamaṃ manyate tasya bhaktirvyarthā maheśvariuttamottamarūpeṇa paśyet sarvamasaṃśayambhāvite varṇamaryādā na kathaṃ vyāhatā bhavetanyathā vartamāno hi labhate varṇavicyutimsamagrā susthirā śuddhā bhaktirmuktiṃ prayacchatiadhaḥ padopalabdhiḥ syādantye sarvāṅgasundarivarṇāśramīyadharmāṇāṃ nirbandhaḥ saphalaḥ smṛtaḥniyamopadeśo nāma navamaḥ paṭalaḥnānāvidhe kathaṃ nu syāt prāyaścittaṃ vadasva me
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāyaścittavidhiṃ vakṣye sadā liṅgāṅgasaṅgināmataḥ ṣaḍadhvasaṃśuddhiyogācchuddhaṃ vidhāya tatna liṅgamapavitraṃ syāt sarvāvasthāsu bhāminina saṃspṛśyaṃ hi malliṅgamiti nirṇītamadrijeanyathā rāṣṭranāśaḥ syāt tasmādanyairna kārayettathāpi tasya kānīnatayā bbrāhmaṇyalopataḥsvaparārthopayuktāyāmadhikuryānna saṃśayaḥlokārādhyatvayogena pratiṣṭhādhikṛto bhavetspṛśanto naiva duṣyanti mama liṅgaṃ suśobhanamadīkṣitaistu spṛṣṭaṃ celliṅgaṃ saṃskāryameva hiliṅgasyādhasthitirbhāvyā kathaṃ doṣaḥ praśāmyatinānyā viniṣkṛtiḥ śastā prātaḥ patyuḥ padānateḥsarvadoṣapraśamanī netrasaṃsparśarūpiṇīadīkṣitaiśca saṃsparśo loke saṃbhāvyate khaluhīnavarṇairapi tathā caṇḍālaiḥ śvapacairapietatsarvaṃ samācakṣva lokānugrahatatparatathā prayatitavyaṃ khalvanyathā niṣkṛtiḥ parāpañcākṣarīṃ ca gāyatrīmaṣṭottaraśataṃ japetśrīrudreṇa ca kartavyaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ suviśeṣataḥgāyatrīṃ mūlamantraṃ ca japtvā naktāśano bhavetmūlamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet taddoṣaśāntayealābhe patrapuṣpāṇāṃ niyatānāṃ ca saṃkhyayāpūjāyāśca japasyāpi lope mūlaṃ sahasrakamekaikasya japedeva mūlamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamtadā vai kiṃ nu karttavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vadasva me
source_edition: Muktabodha M00208 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gṛhītvā tattadā japyaṃ mūlamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamprāyaścittatayā japyaṃ mūlamaṣṭottaraṃ śatamkiṃ nu kāryaṃ tadā deva kṛpayā tannibodha mekṛtvā tattvakalānyāsaṃ pūjayedaviśeṣataḥāropya bibhṛyālliṅgaṃ punarlabdhaṃ guroḥ karātliṅgasyādarśane tyājyāḥ prāṇāḥ syurbhaktiyogataḥnirāhāro japanmūlaṃ liṅgamanveṣayejjanaiḥguruṃ māheśvarāṃcaiva yathāśakti samarcayetprāṇatyāge tvaśaktaścelliṅgamanyad guroḥ karātṣaḍadhvanyāsakalitaṃ bibhṛyādapramādataḥlabhet cet pūrvaliṅgam kartavyaṃ kiṃ vadasva metatpūrvaliṅgaṃ gurave vinivedya kṣipejjaletatkathaṃ brūhi saṃskāryamanarhaṃ liṅgavarjitamcedadhāryamasaṃskāryaṃ gātraṃ tasya bhavet tadāenaṃ me saṃśayaṃ chindhi karuṇāvaruṇālayanānarthastadasutyāgaḥ saṃskārastu yathā śṛṇuliṅgamanyat susaṃyojya saṃskuryād vidhinā tanumtalliṅgaṃ prāṇavad dhāryamapramādena sarvadāaputrāyāpyaśiṣyāya na prakāśyamidaṃ tvayā
